Using the 13F total as the denominator gives 71.5% (formula 217,625 ÷ 304,197) — definition difference: the milestone is judged on the 10-Q definition (including non-US equities). Status remains in progress.
  • D-2027-1 (2027 annual net purchases): Before the judgment year — the 13F does not change the 9M 2026 reference figure of +$11.2 billion (source: 3Q26 10-Q).
  • D4 (AI infrastructure capital intensification): Among positions increased in 3Q, none are data center, power or AI infrastructure names — Alphabet is unchanged (source: 3Q information table). No status change.
  • D5 (buying opportunity in a 'casino market'): 3Q was not a phase of −20% from the S&P 500 peak (judgment), and net sales were $0.43 billion — R6 not satisfied (source: state.probability_adjustment_rules R6).
  • T5 (Bending Spoons additional stake): The 13F lists 20,689,655 shares and $689.4 million at end of 3Q for the first time (not in the 2Q 13F; source: both information tables). The 13F has no ownership percentage or settlement date, so it cannot be distinguished whether this is 'settlement of the additional stake (about 4%)' — T5 remains pending, with the 4Q26 10-K equity note and press reports as the verification path (judgment).

  • Share price update (close): Class B $592.85 (2026-11-16, stockanalysis) — 27.7% above the base present value (formula 592.85 ÷ 464.4 − 1). With the exit P/B fixed at 1.45x, the implied BPS compounding is 10.7% (formula (592.85 × 2.411 ÷ (357.73 × 1.45))^(1/10) − 1).
  • Market cap about $1,261.8 billion (formula 592.85 × 1,418,900 × 1,500) − net cash $356.9 billion − equities $335.5 billion = value assigned to operating businesses about $569.3 billion → 15.0x annualized after-tax operating earnings excluding investment income of $38.08 billion (formula 569,331 ÷ 38,080, same approximation as the first edition).
  • Side note (not a basis for judgment): Form 4 filings for insider purchases of the company's own shares by two executives on 2026-11-12 (CFO Charles Chang, 2 Class A shares, $888,869.52 · General Counsel Marc Hamburg... Michael O'Sullivan, 421 Class B shares, weighted averages $593.75 and $594.40; sources: Form 4 Chang · Form 4 O'Sullivan) — management actions are not input to this probe's judgments.

  • Berkshire 3Q26 13F posted (2026-11-16): 30 issues/classes, total $304.197 billion (13F).
  • Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola and Alphabet share counts unchanged · Bank of America −27.53 million shares (−5.7%, calculated) (fact sheet).

  • Top-5 holdings concentration 65% (9/30, 66% at end of June) — milestone D-2030-1 (≤75%) remains on track (10-Q R14).
  • Rules R1–R6 not met — scenarios 25/50/25 and assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 maintained · Class B 11/16 close $592.85 (stockanalysis).
  • Three data points to check directly before the next issue
  • Bending Spoons ownership stake and acquisition cost — 4Q26 10-K equity note or tier-1 press reports (T5, 3Q fact sheet).
  • Composition of the roughly $31.3 billion of equities outside the 13F (calculated 335,515 − 304,197) — fair value of the Japanese trading house stakes (10-K equity note, 10-Q R14).
  • Yen bond settlement (2026-11-19) and the ¥73.4 billion maturity repayment (2026-11-27) — 4Q26 10-K debt note (T2, 424B5).
